results.title: Rapid SmallSat Mission Formulation: Integrated and Concurrent Modeling in JPL's Team Xc
results.abstract: The Innovation Foundry at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) is developing a new tool suite for rapid concurrent and collaborative spacecraft mission architecture design with Team Xc. Team Xc is JPL's agile and rapid design team for Earth orbiting and interplanetary CubeSat and SmallSat missions of “ESPA-class” (approximately 180 kg mass) and below.
